_doc: Runeward Legion terms for the Wardwright trade (C13, Region 1 balance). Read by scripts/realm/career_trades.gd (stone_work, ward_stipend); ranks and promotion live in ladders.json under "wardwright". The Legion pays a weekly stipend by rank (docked when the player did stone work on fewer than min_days_week days), a small fee for the first mend of a day (the round), a fee scaled by how much a stone needed mending (a sound stone pays nothing extra, so repeat-mending pays nothing), and a fee per glyph carved (at most max_paid_carves a day).
